hook: Your faceless units wear other cards' text, and the longer a disguise goes unnoticed, the bigger the payoff.
loop: Wear the Guise of shop or board units, copying their text.
Worn climbs each turn on every Guise you leave running.
Unmask to cash Worn in as permanent buffs, then re-Guise.

growth.line: Worn rises each Start of Turn; Unmasks and the Nurse pay permanent stats per turn Worn.

feel.early: Copy shop units; thin Tier 2, little real buffing.
feel.mid: Each turn: let Guises run, or Unmask for applause.
feel.late: Copies of your carry, easy triples, a hill of Ladies.

stars.why: The whole loop in one card: wear a Guise, cash in Worn.
Stack and move Worn: time becomes a resource you spend.
The capstone wears every face on your board at once.

card_short.u01: Wears a shop unit's Guise; Unmasked: grows per turn Worn.
card_short.u02: Carves a Stock of a shop unit.
card_short.u03: Wears a Guise with left/right and front/behind flipped.
card_short.u04: End of Turn: may Unmask your longest-Worn unit, small buff.
card_short.u05: Swaps one of your units with a shop unit.
card_short.u06: Gives a friendly unit the Guise of another unit.
card_short.u07: Carves a half-stat Stock of your biggest other unit.
card_short.u08: Wears a shop Guise; Unmasked: buffs touching units per Worn.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: copies the text of the enemy across.
card_short.u10: Each Stock carved or Exchange: buffs all your Changelings.
card_short.u11: Each Unmask buffs your other Changelings per turn Worn.
card_short.u12: A unit taking a Guise fires the copied When played.
card_short.u13: Doubles Worn gain; can move one Guise's Worn onto another.
card_short.u14: Wears your unit's Guise; Guised units count toward triples.
card_short.u15: Twice a fight: carves a Stock of a Changeling's killer.
card_short.u16: Wears biggest unit's Guise, half its stats, then Exchanges it.
card_short.u17: Has the printed text of every other unit you have.
card_short.u18: Stocks keep their source's text; carves a Stock each turn.
card_short.u19: Each turn: buffs Changelings by your longest Worn, capped.
card_short.x01: Textless Changeling token with copied stats; sells for 0.

builds.name: The Long Con
builds.line: Let Guises run, pile Worn with Keeper, cash in once with Usher.

builds.name: The Stock Yard
builds.line: Go wide with Stocks; Bettie buffs every carve, Moll gives them text.

builds.name: A Hill of Ladies
builds.line: Guise or Stock copies of the Lady, each running every buff text.

liked: Copying other tribes' text and tribe makes a new hybrid every lobby.
Run-or-cash choice on Worn gives each midgame turn a real decision.
worries: Knowe Usher is uncapped; Keeper piling Worn makes one Unmask enormous.
The Lady: each extra Lady multiplies buffs again, bounded only by slots.
changed: Seamstress loops capped: each unit fires a copied When played once a turn.
Keeper can now move Worn between Guises; Grandfer's Unmask became optional.
A unit wearing the Lady's Guise, or a Stock of her, is another Lady.
verdict: Copy-combo lovers get a fresh hybrid every lobby and a keep-or-cash choice each turn.
